semantic_findings.assessment: Collector retains complete actual SeedView edits, rejects non-Seed edits and duplicate scope submissions. ACK helper consumes exactly the emitted scope, checks issued scope and exactly one existing model view, and rejects managed issuers. Initial active and hidden ACKs each use the resulting mutable post-Seed model. semantic_findings.assessment: Helper applies actual closed IDs through public View::apply Remove before public Insert(before:None). For ordinary unmanaged unique-owner fixtures, helper skips another-scope ID ownership or different-ID same-resource conflicts rather than overwriting canonical data. Existing target view and unique selected scope are required. Actual fixture constructors use distinct CardId/terminal identities and transfer removes target from old view before adding destination; no ambiguous-owner model is passed by these parents.
